description: Dig (break) the block at a world coordinate, equipping the best tool automatically. Set `action:"stop"` to abort the current dig. This is a cancellable long-running action.

action.description: "start" (default) begins digging; "stop" aborts the current dig.

digFace.description: Face to dig from: "auto", "raycast", or a vector. Default "auto".

forceLook.description: Look at the block before digging; "ignore" to skip looking. Default true.

name: dig
